statement: The rank-one forms x²,y²,(2x+y)² admit no common Z_(2)-orthogonal graph splitting at any positive level although they occur in an algebraic ppav-surface family with algebraic minimal curve class
depends_on: C.4z coordinate-rounding proof; EGFS Mumford survey Proposition2.29 and Corollary2.30
notes: Method limitation only: arbitrary monodromy cones do not admit the proposed graph transfer. No answer to the residual type(1,2) surface splitting gate and no main-gate movement.
